description: This file defines a JavaScript class 'Datetimecombo' for creating and managing a date-time combo widget in a web interface, including rendering HTML for the widget, updating the widget's state, and handling date and time input parsing and formatting.

classes.name: Datetimecombo
classes.description: A class representing a date-time selection widget, encapsulating properties for date and time, and methods to generate HTML, update the widget, and produce JavaScript code.

methods.name: Datimecombo
methods.description: Constructor function to initialize a DateTime combo widget with given parameters, parsing initial datetime, and setting up display properties.

methods.name: jsscript(callback)
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for updating the date-time widget based on user input, suitable for inline script insertion.

methods.name: html(callback)
methods.description: Returns the HTML string to render the date-time widget, including dropdowns for hours, minutes, meridiem, and a checkbox if configured.

methods.name: update(updateListeners)
methods.description: Updates the widget's internal state and corresponding input fields based on user interactions, including handling checkbox toggling.
